content_blocks.text: The sun dipped below the horizon, casting a golden glow over the town square. Sarah stood alone, her eyes fixed on the old clock tower. It was the last signal, a tradition passed down through generations. As the clock struck seven, a soft whisper filled the air—a sound so faint, it was almost imperceptible. She closed her eyes, letting the memory wash over her. Her great-grandfather, a man of great courage and wisdom, had started this ritual decades ago. Today, it was her turn to carry on the legacy. With a deep breath, she whispered back, her voice barely audible, yet filled with the strength of a thousand silent prayers.
